purpose: Provide one machine-readable bundle for preparing API directory, RapidAPI-style and MCP/tool-registry draft submissions without executing irreversible publication or go-live actions.
plain_language_summary: This bundle tells a machine or API directory what MachineSignal is, how to test it in sandbox, what evidence exists, and what must remain blocked before commercial go-live.

recommended_submission_order.reason: Lowest-risk way to make the API understandable to machines without enabling marketplace monetization.
recommended_submission_order.stop_before: Final public submit button or irreversible publication.

recommended_submission_order.reason: Useful for marketplace-style API buyers, but monetization must remain disabled.
recommended_submission_order.action_now: Prepare provider fields and endpoint groups only.
recommended_submission_order.stop_before: Creating public paid plans, public checkout or production credentials.

recommended_submission_order.reason: Best match for machine customers and AI agents because it exposes MachineSignal as callable tools.
recommended_submission_order.action_now: Prepare registry copy for the local stdio adapter and public manifests.
recommended_submission_order.stop_before: Claiming hosted MCP is live or publishing to a registry that requires a hosted endpoint.

recommended_submission_order.reason: Useful as a controlled external machine-testing surface, but public visibility remains blocked.
recommended_submission_order.stop_before: Public workspace publication unless final secret scan and owner approval are recorded.

common_listing_fields.short_description: Machine-first lead opportunity scoring, target discovery and spend-control API for CRMs, AI agents and automated workflows.
common_listing_fields.long_description: MachineSignal helps automated systems decide which business domains deserve more sales, CRM or enrichment budget. The API returns score, confidence, decision, spend policy and next machine action. A machine can start with a list of domains, or request Target Discovery when it has no list. If a score passes the gate, it can request Deep Analysis as a controlled spend layer. Only after Deep Analysis confirms the action gate can it request Action Pack, which returns CRM-ready JSON, workflow payloads, webhook policy, approval gates and stop rules. MachineSignal is currently sandbox-only: no live payment, no fiscal invoice, no external target contact and no automatic outreach.
common_listing_fields.primary_user: Machine: CRM, AI agent, RevOps workflow, enrichment pipeline or software buyer.
common_listing_fields.human_role: Owner supervision, budget approval, legal responsibility and audit.

machine_test_path: POST /v1/purchase-intent only when the score recommends the product and budget rules allow it

remaining_before_public_non_monetized_go: external machine discovery test from a third-party surface
final secret scan after any external platform import
remaining_before_paid_commercial_go_live: terms of service and privacy/commercial terms

recommended_next_step: Use this bundle to prepare a private draft submission rehearsal for a generic API directory first. Stop before irreversible publication or monetization.
